propositions: Mutation test shard enforcement modes (advisory/ratchet/strict) are controlled via .github/mutation-shards.toml and promoted based on evidence from base/head archive comparisons with pinned mutmut 3.7.0
Shard selection maps changed source, test, support files, and global inputs to affected shards, handles renames/deletions, reports unmatched tests, and emits explicit empty-selection state

Per-shard 30-minute job limits and per-mutant timeout derived from (estimated test runtime + 1 second) × 15 prevent unbounded execution; fresh archives with no cached mutation verdicts ensure deterministic results

Ratchet mode preserves unchanged legacy survivors and no-tests outcomes, blocks killed regressions and new survivors on unmodified AST functions, and requires individually reviewed equivalent fingerprints for new/edited functions
Advisory mode publishes all outcomes without blocking mutation-quality findings; strict mode requires every mutant killed or fingerprinted and blocks no-tests, timeouts, and incomplete statuses
Selector-derived per-shard workflow matrix with exact Gerrit patchset checkout, vote.needs integration, weekly/manual all-shard sweeps, and always-published structured evidence artifacts
